profile.headline: AI & ML Engineer | LLMs, RAG & Computer Vision | GenAI | AI Agents | Agentic AI | Data Science Enthusiast | Backend & Cloud
profile.shortBio: AI & ML Engineer with hands-on experience building LLM and RAG systems, computer vision pipelines, agentic AI workflows, and production backend services. Proficient in Python, PyTorch, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, PostgreSQL, Docker, and REST APIs. Passionate about creating impactful, real-world AI solutions.

highlights: Engineered AI-powered LMS modules including a course recommendation engine, conversational AI Coach, automated proctoring, and real-time assessments using Python, Django, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs, supporting 500+ users.

Developed recommendation and dynamic skill-scoring algorithms using learner profiles and outcomes, delivering personalized courses, real-time proficiency updates, and low-latency recommendations; automated assessments achieved 95% evaluation accuracy.

Built and secured scalable backend services and JWT-authenticated REST APIs for application logic, database operations, and frontend integration, while handling testing, debugging, Docker, Git, deployment, and Agile SDLC workflows.
Improved LLM output accuracy by 20% through rigorous testing, evaluation, and refinement across summarization, translation, reasoning, multilingual, and diverse content-generation tasks.

Supported RLHF workflows by generating high-quality human preference annotations and evaluating model responses across economics, medicine, law, and psychology, contributing to more reliable and human-aligned AI systems.
Curated and optimized structured multilingual, multi-domain datasets for AI training and evaluation pipelines, improving data quality, scalability, usability, and overall model reliability.

projects.title: AI Documentation Assistant using RAG
projects.summary: End-to-end RAG system for querying technical documentation with asynchronous ingestion, semantic retrieval, and grounded response generation using Gemini 1.5 Flash and ChromaDB.
features: Async disk-cached ingestion pipeline with concurrent page processing and incremental updates
all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings with ChromaDB for semantic search (800-char chunks, 150-char overlap, top-5 retrieval)
Gemini 1.5 Flash with context-grounding and source-citation prompts for accurate, grounded answers
FastAPI endpoints for querying, retrieval, health checks, and indexing
SQLite-based query logging and response-time tracking

projects.title: AI-Driven Smart Traffic Management System
projects.summary: Real-time vehicle detection pipeline with YOLOv8 achieving mAP of 0.92 for vehicle classification and 0.96 for emergency vehicle detection, using a federated multi-model decision architecture.
features: Real-time vehicle detection with 0.92 mAP (vehicle) and 0.96 mAP (emergency vehicle)
Multi-model decision architecture fusing three YOLOv8 models via priority-based state machine
Adaptive traffic signal control with emergency vehicle priority and automatic lane clearing
Flask REST APIs for vehicle analytics
Live multi-lane monitoring dashboard

projects.title: Frugal Foodie: Cost-Based Restaurant Clustering
projects.summary: Location-based restaurant recommendation system using K-Means clustering, Google Maps API, and Gemini API. Clusters restaurants by pricing with a Silhouette Score of 0.60. Published in JETIR.
features: K-Means clustering for restaurant grouping by cost (Silhouette Score: 0.60)
Google Maps API integration for location-aware recommendations
Gemini API for dynamic, personalized dining suggestions
FastAPI backend with responsive frontend
Published research paper in JETIR journal

projects.title: Spot the Job Scam
projects.summary: ML pipeline to detect fraudulent job postings using TF-IDF, SMOTE, and a stacked ensemble of XGBoost, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression. Achieved F1-score of 0.84 on the fraud class.
features: TF-IDF text features with SMOTE class balancing for fraud detection
Stacked ensemble: XGBoost, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression
F1-score of 0.84 on fraud class (95% precision, 76% recall)
Real-time predictions, confidence scoring, and keyword highlighting
Backend deployed on Render, frontend on Netlify

projects.title: AI for Pandemic Prediction
projects.summary: Regression model predicting pandemic potential using COVID-19 data across 150+ countries. Includes Streamlit dashboard for data visualization.
features: COVID-19 data analysis across 150+ countries
Regression modeling for pandemic potential prediction
Interactive Streamlit dashboard for data visualization
Statistical analysis and trend identification
Real-time data processing and insights
